rows.grounds: Locative of śūnya used for place; refers to an empty house/site in this rite context.
Locative of geha meaning house; paired with śūnye to specify the empty house.
Absolutive of sam-ānī (to bring together/to bring); fused form kept as given.
Conjunction linking the action to what follows.
Compound arghya + ādika (etc.); accusative neuter singular object referring to arghya and related items.
Optative/precative form of viśudh (to purify), 3rd person singular active.

items.question: Where and how must arghya and related items be ritually purified in this instruction?
premises: Ritual action is directed to arghya and related items.
Those items are brought into an empty house setting.
Purification is prescribed as the required procedure there.
items.inference: One should bring arghya and related items into an empty house and then perform purification of them.
items.plain_english: Having brought arghya and the rest into an empty house, one should purify them.
